audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill on rows 0-5 and Qiyana on row 6; content win[] and the packet chart both read Karma/Karma/Skill/Skill/Qiyana/Qiyana/Karma.
audit.why: Karma's 950 Q against a 525-range Elemental Wrath owns levels 1-2; 3-5 is genuinely a dodge check on the Terrashape-into-Audacity entry; the 120s ultimate takes 6 and first item; at 53.45% over 58 games and with Karma's shields answering a single-commit assassin, the grouped late returns to Karma.
audit.corrected: phases[0..1].side to Karma, [2..3] stay Skill, [4..5] to Qiyana, [6] to Karma.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why describe Karma's own Mantra rank and item spike on rows the chart gives to Qiyana.
audit.why: Karma gains no new ultimate at 6; Qiyana gains a flat 120s shockwave that stuns through the wave and starts her full combo.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Supreme Display of Talent and the Audacity entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit and names only Audacity; Terrashape and the ultimate are never named. Separately, the content layer twice describes Qiyana's ultimate as a root.
audit.why: Riot's text says the shockwave detonates whatever elements she hits with it, stunning and damaging nearby enemies — it is a stun, not a root, and the distinction changes whether tenacity applies. Terrashape is the 1100-range dash on a flat 7s; Audacity is the 650-range dash on 11/10/9/8/7.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries E 11/10/9/8/7, W flat 7s and R flat 120s; whys[4] and spikes[1].text corrected from root to stun.

notes: Chart proposed as one atomic group. Rows 0-5 moved the full layer onto the content/packet values, which already agree, so no paired win[N] edit is proposable there (win[0..5] already hold the target strings).
